avis.texte: this cleanser is so gentle omg, skin literally doesn't feel tight or stripped after 🥹 such a solid everyday gel that everyone needs in their routine. also acne prone safe so bonus points

avis.titre: OBSESSED. So happy I can finally restock at Ulta!
avis.texte: I'm super picky about cleansers because I need that extra hydration, and honestly, this one is THE ONE. I actually bought it first when I traveled to Korea earlier this year and fell in love with it. So hyped that I can easily grab it at Ulta now! 10/10 recommend !!!

Its a regular cleanser. Didnt make me feel clean but it did make my face feel hydrated. Though, a big downside is that it left a weird film on my face. Even after drying my fave with a facial towel, any toners or serums turn into a sticky paste because the soap wouldnt wash off.

My all time favorite number one cleanser. I have very dry skin and this is one of the few cleansers that doesn't give me that tight feeling after washing my face. Foams well and no scent. Doesn't sting when I have my rosacea and eczema flare ups. I've gone through 5+ bottles of this.

Light and highly effective facial cleanser. Just as gentle as a cream cleanser, but I prefer textures that bubble. Directions say 2-3 pumps, but thats way too much—a single, half pump lathered well is all you need. I use it twice a day—its gentle in the AM and and a perfect second step double cleanse in the PM (Klairs Gentle Black Deep Cleaning Oil). Even when my skin is sensitized, it has never caused irritation, redness, or tightness. Im 49, with rosacea, very sensitive, dry skin but no problem in any climate—from Chicago winters to the Tucson desert.

Maybe it's all that hyaluronic acid, but my skin feels super hydrated instead of dry after washing. I've been using it for a week, and it's not just taking care of dead skin cells, but also it feels like it's moisturizing deep down. Bonus, it's amazing at keeping my skin's oil-water balance perfectly in check!
